v10_i_remeasurement.recorded_defect: european_residential.py rotates about the LITERAL ORIGIN
v10_i_remeasurement.note: V10.i --- a recorded blocker is re-measured before it is designed around. If it no longer reproduces, that is the finding, and the gate is scored on what the code does TODAY.

cross_crs_area_share_deviation_INFO.why_not_gated: a reprojection is not a similarity transform, so the strip partition shifts by the projection's own distortion. Gating it would be a band this gate never set.

area_share_residue_INFO.verdict: INFO --- reported, NEVER scored: no numeric tolerance on area shares is pre-registered for this gate, and picking one now would be a band change
area_share_residue_INFO.reading: 1e-9 to 5e-7 in AREA SHARE is floating-point conditioning at UTM magnitudes after a 100 km translation, not a different layout: NO building changed its yield or its dwelling count.

G10.10.note: the invariant is the ORDERED VECTOR OF AREA SHARES, not metric areas: metric areas differ between projections by distortion, so comparing them would score the projection and not the layout.
